page.overview:
Who is Chiv?

Commodore Chiv was a male Vulcan Starfleet flag officer who lived during the mid-23rd century.

In 2259, he served as the Starfleet Commander representative on the judge's panel during the court martial of Illyrian Lieutenant Commander Una Chin-Riley. ()
